name: Of The Day: Words, Facts, Quiz

ios.desc:
LEARN SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY - NOW BIGGER THAN EVER!

'Of The Day' is your personal portal to daily learning and delight - now with 10 brand-new features, including four new daily games with global leaderboards.

Start every morning with 40 expertly curated daily features designed to make learning a fun, effortless habit.

* NEW - EXPLORE THE WORLD
• Country, City & UNESCO Site of the Day: Travel the globe from your pocket
• Bird of the Day: A new bird daily - with its real birdsong
• Flower of the Day: A beautiful bloom and its meaning
• Poem & Born On This Day: A daily poem, and who shares today's birthday in history

* NEW - PLAY & COMPETE
• Daily Sudoku: One puzzle a day, the same for everyone — race the world's fastest times
• Word Game of the Day: Guess the daily word and climb a global leaderboard

- DAILY FAVOURITES
• Word of the Day: Expand your vocabulary with words and their stories
• On This Day: Journey through history's most significant moments
• Daily Quiz: Challenge yourself and the world with trivia
• Recipe, Song, Book & Movie of the Day: Never run out of things to cook, hear, read or watch
• Dogs & Cats of the Day: Daily doses of cuteness, with fun facts
• Images, Artwork & Wallpapers: Beautiful visual inspiration every day
• Phrases, Idioms, Jokes, Facts, Advice & Affirmations: A little wisdom and a lot of fun

- BUILD A STREAK
Keep your daily learning streak alive and track your progress over the year.

Perfect for:
• Lifelong learners seeking daily knowledge boosts
• Word, puzzle & trivia fans
• Travel, nature & history lovers
• Pet lovers enjoying daily cuteness
• Anyone making learning a fun daily habit

Features:
• Home & Lock Screen widgets - learn anytime
• 35 categories, fully customisable - show what you love, hide what you don't
• Two daily games with worldwide leaderboards
• Save favourites and revisit them anytime
• Optional daily notifications & offline access
• Submit your pet for "Pet Of The Day" and your advice for "Advice Of The Day"


Make every day an opportunity to learn something new. Download Of The Day NOW and embark on a journey of continuous discovery!

show_hn.title: Show HN: I built an app that replaces mindless scrolling with daily learning

quotes.text:
I got tired of mindless scrolling and wanted a quick, fun way to learn something new every day. So I built Of The Day: New Daily Learning using SwiftUI and a handful of APIs (Wikipedia, NASA, Google Books, TMDB, etc.) to deliver fresh daily content.

You can swipe through categories like:

- Recipe of the Day

- Word of the Day

- Phrase of the Day

- Movie of the Day

- Book of the Day

- Pet of the Day (submit your own pet to be featured!)

- Trivia of the Day (multiple-choice quiz where you see how others answered worldwide)

- Vote of the Day (“This or That” polls)

I built it to spend just 5 minutes a day learning something cool—like new words, random historical facts, or fun cultural tidbits. Would love any feedback, suggestions, or questions. Happy to answer anything and hope you enjoy checking it out!

Link to the app: - https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/of-the-day-new-daily-learning/id6741198633
